Observed at +10.324785470962524s — page 7
es/get-a-study.md): One study's full read: execution settings (model, system prompt, tool-approval policy, attached servers, share
link), the environment it publishes, and the insights envelope over its latest analyzed window.\n- [Update a scenario](https://do
cs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/update-a-scenario.md): Change a study's identity or its exposure, but not both in one call. **
Send `mode` on its own.** Identity and exposure are separate operations upstream, and applying them in sequence could leave the st
udy live in a mode you did not ask for.\n- [List a scenario's sessions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/list-a-scena
rios-sessions.md): What visitors did, as summaries. Project members only: this route is deliberately absent from the guest allowli
st, so a share-link visitor can never read other visitors' sessions.\n- [Get a session transcript](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-ref
erence/studies/get-a-session-transcript.md): The projected transcript, paged. Tool payloads and blobs are dropped, and the stored
blob URL is never returned.\n- [Set the guest-execution caps](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/set-the-guest-executio
n-caps.md): The spend dial for anonymous visitors. A FULL REPLACEMENT. Send every field. These caps only mean something as a set,
and a partial update that raised one while leaving another stale would produce a combination nobody chose.\n- [Rotate the share li
nk](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/rotate-the-share-link.md): Mints a new share link and stops the old URL from gra
nting access. Everyone you shared it with needs the new one.\n- [Invite a member](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/in
vite-a-member.md): Upsert by email, so re-inviting somebody is not an error. Only meaningful while `mode` is `invited_only`.\n- [R
emove a member](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/remove-a-member.md): Removal NARROWS access, so it bumps `accessVers
ion` and cuts off any session that member already had: it takes effect at once rather than at expiry.\n- [Point a scenario at a di
fferent environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/point-a-scenario-at-a-different-environment.md): Keeps the stud
y's LINK, its members and its session history while changing what visitors actually reach. The alternative, unpublish and republis
h, mints a new link, which means re-sharing it with everyone.\n- [Session metrics](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/s
ession-metrics.md): Volumes, completion and feedback rates over the study's sessions.\n- [Usage breakdown](https://docs.mcpjam.com
/api-reference/studies/usage-breakdown.md): Which models, tools and servers the study's sessions used.\n- [Current window signals]
(https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/current-window-signals.md): What the miner extracted from the current window, and w
here you get the window id the insights read takes.\n- [List scenario findings](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/list
-scenario-findings.md): Every finding raised over this study's windows, dismissed ones included: dismissal is a state on the findi
ng, not a deletion.\n- [Read a window's insights](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/read-a-windows-insights.md): Poll
this after requesting a generation.\n- [Request insights for the current window](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/req
uest-insights-for-the-current-window.md): **No credits are consumed**: the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the study's
current window and draws on the organization's `insightsPerDay` ledger, which counts REQUESTS and is SHARED with eval-run and swar
m run insights, so a request here takes one from there.\n- [Cancel a window's generation](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/st
udies/cancel-a-windows-generation.md): Releases a generation that is stuck `pending`. Idempotent against an already-finished one.\
n- [Dismiss a finding](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/dismiss-a-finding.md): Keyed on the finding's stable remediat
ion id, so the same problem stays dismissed when insights regenerate. Bodyless: the path names the finding.\n- [Restore a dismisse
d finding](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/restore-a-dismissed-finding.md): Undoes a dismissal. Bodyless: the path n
ames the finding.\n- [Create (or revive) a relay tunnel for a named project server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/tunnels/
create-or-revive-a-relay-tunnel-for-a-named-project-server.md): Registers a server record named `name` if missing, mints a relay t
unnel grant for it, and **persists the tunnel bearer URL (including the plaintext `?k=` secret) onto the server record's `url`** s
o evals and studies can target the tunnel like any remote server. **Every call rotates the secret, revok…\n- [Revoke a tunnel's li
ve grant](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/tunnels/revoke-a-tunnels-live-grant.md): Revokes the grant: the public URL stops w
orking immediately and any live tunnel session is disconnected. The server record, including its now-dead `url`, is intentionally
left untouched, so the next create revives the tunnel with the same slug.\n- [Run one headless agent turn](https://docs.mcpjam.com
/api-reference/agent/run-one-headless-agent-turn.md): Runs ONE assistant turn over the supplied message history and responds synch
ronously with the final assistant text, the operations it invoked, references to any resources it created, and any actions awaitin
g human approval.\n- [Connect an MCP server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-connections/connect-an-mcp-server.md): S
tarts a connection request for an MCP server URL. Discovery, browser consent, and validation happen asynchronously; poll the retur
ned `connectionRequestId` until the status is terminal. When the next step belongs to a person, the response carries a `handoffUrl
` to open.\n- [Get a connection request](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-connections/get-a-connection-request.md): Cu
rrent state of one connection request. Metered on its own poll budget rather than the shared per-caller one, so polling on a short
interval is expected and will not spend the budget your other calls need. A 429 here means the poll interval itself is too fast;
honour Retry-After.\n- [Cancel a connection request](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-connections/cancel-a-connection-
request.md): Stops a request and invalidates its handoff link. Cancelling an already-terminal request is a no-op.\n- [Retry valida
tion](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-connections/retry-validation.md): Re-arms a stalled validation immediately inst
ead of waiting out its backoff. Does not revive a terminal request: after `failed`, `expired`, or `cancelled`, start a new one.\n-
[List personas](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/list-personas.md): The project's personas, newest first. Archived pe
rsonas are excluded.\n- [Create a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/create-a-persona.md): Creates one persona.
To draft several with a model first, use `POST /projects/{projectId}/personas/generate`: that route persists nothing.\n- [Get a p
ersona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/get-a-persona.md): A persona that lives in a DIFFERENT project answers 404, n
ever 403: the route is not an existence oracle for a project you cannot see.\n- [Delete a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-ref
erence/swarms/delete-a-persona.md): Refused with 409 while goals still reference this persona: deleting it would strand them.\n- [
Update a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/update-a-persona.md): Partial update. Goals reference the persona b
y id, so renaming one does not disturb anything pointing at it.\n- [Draft personas with a model](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refer
ence/swarms/draft-personas-with-a-model.md): Returns DRAFTS and persists nothing; save the ones you want with the create routes. T
here is no idempotency key, and retries return different drafts.\n- [Draft journeys for a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-ref
erence/swarms/draft-journeys-for-a-persona.md): Returns DRAFTS and persists nothing. See `POST /projects/{projectId}/personas/gene
rate` for why, and for the quota this counts against.\n- [Get a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/get-a-journe
y.md)\n- [Archive a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/archive-a-journey.md): ARCHIVES rather than deletes, and
